title: PostMessage input
description: Post one signed envelope to one inbox. The input is the envelope. The service checks the signature and the authority before it stores anything; a refused post stores nothing and the refusal is the sender's answer.

on_behalf_of.description: The principal whose word this is; `from` itself when the sender speaks for nobody else.

expires.description: Mandatory. A client that is given none writes `created` plus 24 hours.

inbox.messaging.Address.title: Address
inbox.messaging.Address.description: The address of an inbox: `agent:<host>/<session-name>` or `human:<name>`. `group:<name>` is reserved; version 1 opens no group inbox, and a sender that addresses several inboxes posts one envelope to each under one `thread`.

inbox.messaging.Body.title: Body
inbox.messaging.Body.description: The text of a message or a reply, at most 65536 bytes of UTF-8.

inbox.messaging.DecisionAsk.title: DecisionAsk
inbox.messaging.DecisionAsk.description: What a decision asks. The deadline is the envelope's `expires`; the option silence takes is the envelope's `default_on_silence`.

request_ref.description: The id of the decision request this envelope carries, where another system records it (for example an `sdc.decision.DecisionRequest`). The inbox never records the decision.

inbox.messaging.DedupKey.title: DedupKey
inbox.messaging.DedupKey.description: The sender's key for one logical message. A sender with no key of its own writes the message id.

inbox.messaging.DelegationId.title: DelegationId
inbox.messaging.DelegationId.description: The id of a delegation that lets `from` speak for `on_behalf_of`. The SignatureVerifier port resolves it; the inbox stores no delegation.

inbox.messaging.Kind.title: Kind
inbox.messaging.Kind.description: note: handled when read. request: handled when answered or refused. decision: a request with lettered options, which silence may answer.

inbox.messaging.MessageId.title: MessageId
inbox.messaging.MessageId.description: A ULID the sender sets. A sender that posts a message again sends the same id.

inbox.messaging.Principal.title: Principal
inbox.messaging.Principal.description: Who sends, or whose word a message is: `agent:<host>/<session-name>` or `human:<name>`. The SignatureVerifier port decides which key speaks for which principal.

inbox.messaging.ReplyShape.title: ReplyShape
inbox.messaging.ReplyShape.description: What a reply to a request must look like. free: any text. lines: at most this many lines. schema: a reference to a JSON Schema the reply body must satisfy.

inbox.messaging.Signature.title: Signature
inbox.messaging.Signature.description: The key id and the Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of every other envelope field.

inbox.messaging.ThreadId.title: ThreadId
inbox.messaging.ThreadId.description: The ULID that ties the envelopes of one fan-out together: a request sent to 11 inboxes is 11 messages with one thread. A message sent to one inbox carries its own id.
